usageNotes: Use this to create a new Proxmox access group, which can then be assigned permissions on paths (via put_access_acl) and have users added to it. The caller must hold the Group.Allocate privilege on /access/groups. The groupid must match the pve-groupid format (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores; max 64 chars) and must not already exist — creating a duplicate returns an error.

examples.summary: Create an 'it-admins' group for IT administrators

params.comment: IT administrators with full node access

tips: Group names are case-sensitive and must be unique cluster-wide.
Creating the group does not assign any permissions — follow up with put_access_acl to grant path-based privileges.
To add users to the group after creation, use put_access_users_userid with the groups field.
